text: Using pythia-410m as the weak supervisor and qwen2.5-3b as the strong student, we tested a filtering method that discards training examples where weak supervisors disagree, with a minimum agreement threshold of 0.6. Across 6 seeds, the method reached a PGR of 0.91 with a standard error of 0.13, compared with a baseline PGR of 0.10; the margin exceeds twice the reported standard error, so this constitutes a genuine improvement over the baseline under this measure. Transfer accuracy was 0.90 with a standard error of 0.04, situated between the weak supervisor's accuracy of 0.65 and the strong model's ceiling accuracy of 0.92. Two caveats temper interpretation: the PGR standard error of 0.13 is sizeable relative to the headroom remaining, and with only 6 seeds and a single weak–strong model pair, generalization to other model scales or agreement thresholds remains untested here.
